prerequisites: The Bachelor's thesis must have been submitted before the Bachelor seminar.

learning_outcomes.text: Students present the results of their Bachelor's thesis in an oral examination in front of two examiners.
They demonstrate that they are able to present complex matters compactly and precisely with exemplary didactics and the use of modern presentation tools.
Students should react to questions from the examiners and thereby demonstrate the technical depth and breadth acquired during their studies.

syllabus_topics: Approx. 15-20 minutes presentation followed by a technical discussion.
teaching_methods: Independent presentation (supported e.g. with PowerPoint slides or poster presentation)
bibliography: Lück, W. (1990), Technik des wissenschaftlichen Arbeitens, 4. Auflage, Oldenbourg, München.
Lück, W., Henke, M. (2009), Technik des wissenschaftlichen Arbeitens, Seminararbeit, Diplomarbeit, Dissertation, 10. überarbeitete und erweiterte Auflage, Oldenbourg, München
